notes: One file for both themes: futureagi-dark.svg (the silver favicon star) should be removed so the purple star shows in dark mode too. DECISION: futureagi.com, its favicon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png, the docs header (src/components/Logo.astro) and the GitHub org avatar all draw the star in silver/white, i.e. monochrome; the purple star exists only in the logo files of its docs repo (public/logo/Icon.svg, logo_light.svg, logo_dark.svg, committed 2026-03-03). If you judge the site's silver star to be the current mark, the alternative is verdict monochrome-brand, but the silver star's light faces (#F3F3F3/#E6E6E7) vanish on the light tile, which is why the light file was purple in the first place.
